verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਕੈ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਮਹਾ ਭਾਰਥ ਸੇ ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਾਹੂਐ ਨ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pa(n)ch parapa(n)ch kai bhe hai mahaa bhaarath se pa(n)ch maar kaahooaai na dhubidhaa nivaaree hai ||

en.bdb: During the times of Mahabharat, there had many warriors like the five Pandavas in the past but none ever endeavoured to end his duality by destroying the five vices residing within.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਤਜਿ ਨਵਿ ਨਾਥ ਸਿਧਿ ਜੋਗੀਸੁਰ ਹੁਇ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ਮੈ ਤਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gireh taj nav naath sidh jogeesur hui na tiragun ateet nij aasan mai taaree hai ||

en.bdb: Renouncing home and family, many became the Masters, Sidhs and sages, but none had engrossed his mind in the higher spiritual state by keeping oneself free of the effect of the three traits of maya.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧੈ ਜਗੁ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਸਮੋਧ ਮਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨ ਹਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: bedh paaTh paR paR pa(n)ddit prabodhai jag sakai na samodh man tirasanaa na haaree hai ||

en.bdb: A learned person imparts knowledge to the world by studying the Vedas and other scriptures, but he could not bring around his own mind nor end his worldly desires.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥੪੫੭॥
verses.translit_en: pooran braham gurdhev sev saadh sa(n)g sabadh surat liv braham beechaaree hai ||457||

en.bdb: A devoted Sikh of the Guru who in the company of saintly persons, and serving the Lord-like True Guru has engrossed his mind in the divine word, is in reality the real scholar of the Lord.  (457)
